name: Harmonized SKU
purpose: Gives each product one stable identifier across sales channels, so systems and people stop reconciling channel-specific SKUs by hand.
content_html: The canonical SKU generated for a product, formed as CPG- plus the last 8 digits of its GTIN. It is stored on the golden record and pushed back to every channel as a separate field. It never replaces a channel's native SKU.

name: Price Authority
purpose: Names which system decides a product's price when channels disagree, so price conflicts resolve the same way every time.
content_html: Shopify is the price authority. When Shopify and the AWS Marketplace disagree on price, the Shopify price becomes the golden price and the AWS Marketplace price is aligned to it.

name: Channel Price Variance
purpose: Defines the gap between a channel's price and the golden price, so drift can be monitored and queried directly.
content_html: The difference between a channel's listed price and the golden price for the same product, expressed as a percentage of the golden price. Any non-zero variance on a matched product is price drift.

name: Canonical Product ID
purpose: Establishes the shared identifier used to recognise the same product in different channels.
content_html: The product's 13-digit GTIN. It is the only match key in DataHub. A record with a missing or malformed GTIN cannot be matched and is quarantined.
